### Telling the Truth - One Year Devotions for Women
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/telling-the-truth-one-year-devotions-for-women-june-4.html
Passage: Jeremiah 45:5
Points:
- Baruch faced the temptation to seek personal honor instead of faithfully delivering God's hard truth.
- God's servants must share His message even when the surrounding culture rejects and despises it.
- Opponents may try to suppress or destroy Scripture, but God ensures His word endures.
- Believers are called to resist selfish ambition and remain loyal witnesses regardless of the personal cost.

### Bible Pathways - August 27, 2005
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-august-27-2005-1347066.html
Passage: Jeremiah 45:1-5
Points:
- Baruch struggled with discontentment, feeling that his role as Jeremiah's scribe was beneath him.
- Rather than grieving over the impending national tragedy, Baruch fixated on his own lack of recognition.
- The Lord strongly corrected Baruch for pursuing selfish ambition and personal greatness.
- True spiritual fulfillment comes from accepting God's providential placement and serving Him with contentment.
